cc:Work.dc:title: f03_alternate
cc:Work.dc:description: Four plots expose every native pair against block index. The 32B crossing shows a consistent gap between the two arm times, unlike the noncrossing history. Both separate 8B conversations retain blocks with either arm faster. Individual intervals accompany the two primary endpoints and the supporting comparisons.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24313b
